component.name: WaDAWko
component.summary: Write, hear and rehearse taiko pieces in kuchi shōga
Escreva, ouça e ensaie músicas de taiko em kuchi shōga

description.p: WaDAWko is a score editor and small DAW for taiko groups. Pieces are written in kuchi shōga, the spoken syllables of the drums (don, doko, ka, tsuku…), on a grid with one row per instrument.

ul.li: Sections with repeats, dynamics, crescendo, tempo changes and kiai
Playback with real taiko samples, loop, metronome, count-in and a practice trainer
Generated score, a note highway for rehearsal, and a mixer per player
Export to JSON, WAV, MP3, SVG, PNG and PDF
Keyboard first: command palette, jump labels and optional vim mode

description.p: O WaDAWko é um editor de partituras e uma pequena DAW para grupos de taiko. As músicas são escritas em kuchi shōga, as sílabas faladas dos tambores, numa grade com uma linha por instrumento.

screenshot.caption: The grid: sections, one row per instrument and the syllable of each cell

description.p: First release of the native app (Rust + GPUI).
